note: P repeats one hover mechanism (radial glow behind the button, translateY lift, blurred tail, same ease family) across four pages whose hero and button structure nearly match, with P3 and P4 especially alike (dark navy hero, cream primary button, tuning controls). Q varies the motion vocabulary more (sheen sweep, spin, bump, drifting motes, aura and ring pulses, press-state specimens) and the palettes (violet/rose on pastel, mint/sky, dark navy on lavender), though Q2 and Q3 share the Lumen name, pastel blobs and violet-rose gradient, and the sheen sweep recurs in all four.
